FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated.note: Calibrated on the tick replay (REPORT.md): large bursts at a tight spread, stop orders only, far target, trail layer 150 points behind the best price. Development build: TradingEnabled stays false. Verify in the Strategy Tester (real ticks, execution delay about 150 ms) before anything else.

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_NoT.note: The calibrated preset with no trailing at all: highest average profit factor in the replay, about a third more drawdown (REPORT.md section 10).

FlashGold_Micro1s_Calibrated.note: Same changes on the 1 s micro preset. As shipped, the micro filter blocks all entries after 4096 occupied buckets (about 68 minutes) until the EA is restarted; see REPORT.md section 11.

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_ent.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the entry inputs around the calibrated preset. Real ticks, execution delay about 150 ms, forward period 1/3.

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_exi.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of stop, target and trail-layer distance around the calibrated preset. InpReferenceSpreadPts sets the trail-layer distance: 3.33 x the larger of the live spread and this value, capped by InpTrailOuterCapPts (30 = 100 points, 45 = 150, 60 = 200).

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_sim.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the simple trailing on the calibrated entries (trail layer off, burst-settle wait off).

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_fla.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the FlashGold gate strictness around the calibrated preset: band around the armed level and entry distance, both in ATR.

FlashGold_NativeReference_shipped_traili.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the simple trailing on the SHIPPED entries, with the burst-settle wait off so that trailing can act at all (as shipped: start 270 is beyond the 180 target and the settle rule needs a 100 pip pullback).
